verdict.rationale: Dover's own marketing says it provides an AI-generated careers page, and its docs mention hosting a custom careers page. However, the 'custom' version runs through the Dover API, which implies engineering work, and nothing shows a page served on the customer's own domain with branding that publishes jobs straight from the ATS. missing for 10: custom-domain hosting evidence, branding/customization controls, explicit automatic job publishing from the ATS with no code, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Get an AI-generated careers page and job descriptions
host a custom careers page with the Dover API
